paragraphs: GovPilot sells cloud-based management software to municipal and county government departments. The pitch is to put a government's data and its departments on a single platform. Local governments of all sizes have deployed it.

A government picks the modules it needs, then unifies data across departments and lets residents report concerns, apply, pay and track requests online. The catalog runs to more than 125 templated digital modules, with mobile apps and a GIS map on the same cloud platform. A parcel-level view called PropertyProfile shows records held by different departments about the same property. Two mobile apps, GovAlert and GovInspect, accompany the digital forms and automated workflows.

Case studies on the site cover work such as building and construction permitting. Short-term rental property registration is another documented use. Pricing is set by population and by the number of modules a government selects. The company says it has been named a GovTech 100 company for eight consecutive years. It also points buyers to its Capterra reviews from government users.

quote.text: Say goodbye to paper forms and single-purpose software.
